Which forms get their own card?

Regional forms (Alolan, Galarian, Hisuian, Paldean) already have their own card, page and Fast tick square. Everything here is still one card per number with its forms inside, like Unown. Click Own cards on any you want listed separately, then tell Claude the line at the bottom (or click Copy and paste it).

The split into big forms and looks-only is Claude’s suggestion, from the main games. Form names are the game’s.
